tool: Native pixel sprite generator; concept references originally made with built-in image_gen
scope: 全部66张法术图标已统一为16px游戏贴图，保留三类类型框；双重施放重绘为两张错位分开的完整卡牌，显示名与玩法未修改。

namingSchemes.arcane: ① 原初术式：短名、术式感、由说明补足精确机制。
namingSchemes.clear: ② 清晰奇幻：名字可以推测用途，兼顾独立世界观与易读性。
namingSchemes.relic: ③ 遗物铭文：法术以刻片/刻印/铭文为实物，适合探索获取。

namingRules: 保留穿刺、反弹、治疗等清楚的通用机制词，不以生僻词替代所有术语。
并咒表示同时施放多个法术链，拓印表示复制后方单卡，寄咒表示将独立术式储存在载体内。
尚未选择具体方案；各方案可与任意画风组合，不修改既有法术ID。
imageConstraints: 概念板仅记录画风参考，不是真实游戏贴图。当前资源使用12×12原生主体配16×16类型框；禁止缩小高分辨率插画代替逐像素设计。
commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Minecraft magic mod inventory-icon art-direction proposal, NOT a screenshot and NOT a finished sprite export.
Create one beautiful, disciplined comparison board for one art direction, landscape composition around 1536 by 1024. Dark charcoal neutral flat background, six isolated LARGE pixel-art item icons in a spacious 3-column by 2-row grid. Main focus the six sprites, not presentation decorations. Make icons visually convincing as coarse logical 32x32 sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels: crisp square pixels, strong chunky silhouettes, limited deliberate flat palette, 2-3 discrete shade bands per material, no gradients, no bloom, no blur, no soft particles, no anti-aliasing, no realistic texture noise, no micro-detail. Readable at inventory scale. These should feel like original collectable magic items, NOT modern app icons.
Identical subject order for all proposal boards: 1 top left a compact fire projectile/fire seed with clear ember core; 2 top middle concentrated light, three gathered rays becoming one bright spear; 3 top right an inward gravity core, asymmetrical inward bending pieces around a dark void, NOT a ringed planet; 4 bottom left a sharp circular rotating cutting blade with chunky teeth; 5 bottom middle a piercing modifier, one sharp projectile visibly passing through two slabs; 6 bottom right a double-cast instruction, one starting mark branching into two identical outgoing spell marks, NOT two playing cards. Each subject must have a distinct silhouette and clear functional metaphor. No shared circular badge, no enclosing coin, no ornate card frames, no generic plus-sign overlays, no Noita imagery, no game logos.
Top margin only the single requested large Latin option letter and its English title, small icon numerals 1 2 3 4 5 6 adjacent to the grid cells, no other lettering. Bottom margin one understated horizontal inventory strip repeating all six designs at a much smaller scale, crisp pixels, in simple grey Minecraft-like square inventory slots. Show the actual proposed sprite style again in miniature, not different sprites. The large sprites must remain the dominant visual area, with plenty of empty space between them.

2 CONCENTRATED LIGHT:
Replace the green open V / greater-than symbol entirely. Actual in-game palette verified from source: bright warm-white spine RGB(255,253,233), golden side-light RGB(255,204,88), amber shadow RGB(246,193,66). NO GREEN.
Depict ONE filled, horizontal, concentrated lance of warm-white light with golden edges. A broad luminous tail at left narrows smoothly in coarse stepped pixels to a concentrated bright point at right, with a short thin white-gold beam continuing a little beyond that point. It should feel like a compact mass of light compressing into a laser, NOT an arrow or a physical spear. White filled core dominant, gold only hard-edged outer color bands. Allow at most two very short, unequal parallel light traces close behind its broad tail to convey light gathering; NO symmetrical two diagonal arms, NO empty central V wedge, NO closed triangle, NO ">" mathematical shape, NO chevron, NO explosion star, NO weapon, lens, focusing machine, gems or surrounding particles. A single cohesive luminous beam-shaped sprite; simple silhouette built from large blocks. Read as light, not a UI arrow.

5 PIERCING THROUGH AN ENEMY:
Delete the wall/slab. This modifier passes THROUGH ENEMIES, NOT terrain.
Show ONE very simple blocky enemy silhouette, unmistakably a Minecraft-like zombie body: a square head above a wider rectangular torso, short arms and two separated short legs. Muted grey-green silhouette, a few dark grey shadow blocks; head and legs MUST be visible, not an anonymous slab. No face detail necessary, no armor or held weapon.
One small narrow cyan-white projectile travels HORIZONTALLY LEFT TO RIGHT THROUGH THE CHEST. Its shaft is visible approaching from the left and emerges on the right, aligned at the same height. The projectile may visibly overlap a narrow stripe of the chest to make the pass-through clear, while the enemy silhouette stays legible. ONE enemy only, ONE projectile, no second wall, no purple barrier, no wall outline, no blood, no numbers, no exploding enemy, no impact spark cloud or decorative movement arcs.
Enemy should be the clear dominant central silhouette and projectile just enough to communicate continuing THROUGH its body.

Both revised bottom thumbnails must match the new designs, not preserve green V or wall.
Style invariants: crisp opaque coarse square pixel clusters, few flat shades, no anti-aliasing, gradients, painterly texture, soft bloom, realistic material rendering, microscopic highlights, new words or extra sprites. Original concept proposals; not a gameplay screenshot or exported sprite sheet.

coarsePixelRevision.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: six original coarse pixel-art spell icon proposals for a Minecraft mod, not game screenshot.
Input image 1: the user's narrow pale-green converging light spell example, reference ONLY for what converging light means. Light converges from upper-left and lower-left toward one point at right; NOT a single straight beam. Do not trace its exact pixels.
Input image 2: user-provided spell atlas, reference ONLY for low pixel density, few colors, simple symbolic silhouettes, and economical readable composition. Do NOT copy the atlas or its art.
Input image 3: our previous six-icon board, reference ONLY for six subjects and their order. Its sprites are TOO HIGH RESOLUTION and TOO DETAILED. REDRAW every icon at dramatically coarser density. Do NOT preserve the bevels, finely shaded edges or detailing.
Primary request: each icon should look actually designed on a tiny 16 by 16 pixel canvas, in the large chunky pixel language of vanilla Minecraft items. NOT a detailed 64/128px illustration with a pixel filter. Each visible logical pixel should be a huge consistent square in the enlarged view. Use sparse, carefully placed block clusters, just 4-6 colors PER icon, at most 2 shadow/highlight steps, no bevel bands, no tiny stray highlights, no textures. Every icon's entire silhouette is only about 12-16 pixels across. Think 16 rows, not 50 rows. Large solid flat shapes, recognisable at native inventory size.
Composition: flat dark charcoal-purple background (no vignette or gradients); six equally sized icon samples in a spacious 3-column by 2-row grid; large nearest-neighbor-like enlargement so big pixel squares are evident. Small labels 1 through 6 OUTSIDE sprites. A plain small header "SPELL ICONS / PIXEL STUDY". Bottom: six smaller copies of these exact icons in understated grey square inventory slots. Plenty of empty space; no fancy board, no text descriptions.
1 FIREBALL upper left: simple orange ball with pale yellow center and one short red/orange flame tail diagonally upper-left. Three broad color clusters, one coherent flame, no individual sparks, hardware, or decorations.
2 CONCENTRATED LIGHT upper middle: ONLY the phenomenon of light concentrating; two or three thick PALE LIME / IVORY light traces starting spread apart at left, taper and converge into a single bright meeting point on the right, followed by at most a short light tip. An open converging wedge, clean angular stepped lines. Empty charcoal space between converging branches. WHITE core and light green edge with dark olive accent, 4 colors maximum. User's image 1 conveys the concept. No gold straight bar, no arrowhead, no focusing device, no jewel, no stars or spellcaster, no frame.
3 BLACK HOLE upper right: purple and indigo arms curling inward around a generous pure-black hole, simple 3-arm swirl with large square steps, perhaps 4 colors total. Keep the beloved inward spiral concept but radically simplify the facets. No ivory fragments, jewels, floating debris, stars or physical orbit.
4 SAWBLADE lower left: unmistakable one connected steel-grey circular saw with only 6-8 large sharp teeth and a dark 2x2-pixel axle hole. Plain silver/grey/dark-purple shadow palette, NO cyan decorative inlays. Coarse inventory saw, not realistic machined object; no rotation arc, particles or extra tools.
5 PIERCING lower middle: very simple narrow pale-cyan projectile shaft going right through a plain thin grey-purple barrier. Enough shaft visible on both sides. One barrier only, 4 flat colors. No spear handle, jewels, engravings or particles.
6 DRAW TWO lower right: EXACTLY TWO EMPTY rectangular cards offset slightly and fanned apart so two silhouettes can be counted. Pale parchment/ivory faces with dark purple simple outlines and at most one darker paper shade; NO card-face symbols, lightning, energy, output projectiles, numbers, arrows, particles or any third card. This card only draws two cards, so two empty cards are the COMPLETE icon.
Critical aesthetic: low-resolution charm like ORIGINAL vanilla Minecraft item sprites. Large deliberate square clusters rather than smooth detailed shape tessellation. Unity from the identical coarse grid and economical palettes, not from adding artifacts or shared ornaments. Original shapes with user references guiding density and semantics only.
Avoid high-res pixel illustrations, thin filigree, multiple contour highlight bands, gradients, glow haze, anti-aliasing, smooth diagonal edges, small texture dithering, intricate facets, material rendering, detailed enamel, reflective metal, black enclosing coin frames, and copying exact source sprites.
